title: Coppertail Brewing Co
specs: 34,000 sq ft production brewery with 50 barrel brewhouse
20 taps of beer, cider, and THC seltzer in taproom
Must be at least 14 years old to go on the tour
Must be 21 or older to have any samples during the tour
Infants allowed if held by parent during entire tour
Shirts and shoes required (sandals okay, closed-toed recommended)
Event loft rental for up to 300 guests with private bar and amenities
Private tasting room for 10-20 guests with bartender and amenities
includes: beer token good for any beer on tap
blurb: Guests can take a 30-minute brewery tour on weekends to see the brewing process and learn about the historic building. Tours include a souvenir pint glass and a beer token for any beer on tap. The taproom offers 20 rotating beers, scratch-made food, and a unique Tampa atmosphere with seating, TVs, and a patio.
extraNote: Tours may be cancelled by guide at any time · Certain areas may be inaccessible due to maintenance, safety, or operations · Coppertail Tap Room & Kitchen inside the historic Ybor City brewery
